highlights.title: MAI voices for speech
highlights.text: Generate speech with MAI-Voice-2.1 or its Flash variant, each offering 97 voices and MP3 or PCM output. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: MAI transcription, two ways
highlights.text: Transcribe multilingual audio files with timed segments using `microsoft/mai-transcribe-2`, or send live PCM audio to `microsoft/mai-transcribe-2-streaming`. [Browse the file transcription model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft/mai-transcribe-2).

highlights.title: GPT-6 Luna Decisions
highlights.text: Use `openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions` for text or JSON decisions, including streaming requests. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions).

highlights.title: Fable Finder
highlights.text: Give it a lesson you keep forgetting; get a four-line fable and an illustration. [Try it](https://mhmdrizki803-boop.github.io/fable-finder).

highlights.title: Nice No
highlights.text: Turn an awkward request into a gentle, firm, or brief boundary message, with a follow-up for pushback. [Try it](https://nice-no.maxtoms21.chatgpt.site).

highlights.title: Two long-context text models
highlights.text: Try `anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` and `stepfun/step-5-preview` for text and image input, tool calls and 1M-token contexts. Both are paid-only models available through the [text API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Responses for every Chat model
highlights.text: Models available through Chat Completions can now be called through `/v1/responses`, including Claude, Gemini, community models and chat-only agents. See the [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Publish non-streaming text models
highlights.text: Community publishers can register OpenAI-compatible endpoints that return JSON without SSE. Streaming clients still receive a valid event stream, with the full answer delivered at once.

highlights.title: Pi in a browser workbench
highlights.text: Pi Workbench runs upstream Pi in the browser, with a terminal, file access, HTML previews and project ZIP downloads. Visitors can connect their own Pollinations account.

highlights.title: Polish a Japanese memo
highlights.text: Keigo Formatter turns rough Japanese notes into polite business Japanese using the Pollinations text API. [Try it](https://ucalis-uma.github.io/keigo-formatter).

highlights.title: Two Nex reasoning models
highlights.text: Try paid-only `nex-agi/nex-n2.5-pro` and `nex-agi/nex-n2.5-mini` with text or image input. Pro also supports tool calling. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Mistral Large 4 added
highlights.text: Use paid-only Mistral Large 4 for text and image input, reasoning, and tool calling. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: More video reference options
highlights.text: Pass image, video, or audio reference URLs to video generation through the SDK, including arrays of URLs. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: SoloForge AI joins the catalog
highlights.text: Turn content ideas into generated assets, review them, and organize publishing workflows with Pollinations image generation. [Try it](https://soloforge-ai-web.onrender.com).

highlights.title: Audio joins the catalog
highlights.text: Try this community text-to-speech app; its BYOP access requires sign-in. [Try it](https://dwikatmahmoud87-source.github.io/Gtdcg).

highlights.title: Eleven v4 speech models
highlights.text: Generate speech with `elevenlabs/eleven-v4` or `elevenlabs/eleven-v4-turbo`, including timestamped output. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Nano Banana 2.1 images
highlights.text: Generate or edit images with `google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1`, using up to 14 reference images. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Grok Imagine video
highlights.text: Create 1–15 second clips from text or a starting image with `x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite`, at up to 1080p. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Keys that follow model categories
highlights.text: Give an API key access to a category such as image or audio instead of updating its model list whenever a new model is added. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Two new image models
highlights.text: Generate or edit images with FLUX.3 Image and Seedream 5.0 Flash. Both support up to ten editing references and 1K or 2K output. [Explore image models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models).

highlights.title: Liquid D1 and Ling
highlights.text: Try `liquid/d1` for decision tasks or `inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash` for text, tools, and reasoning. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Typed decisions in the SDK
highlights.text: Call the existing decisions endpoint through `@pollinations/sdk` with typed `decision({ state, questions, model? })` inputs and responses. [See the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: Find the right model
highlights.text: Search and filter the model catalog by capabilities or agent. `/v1/models` also includes category tags that Open WebUI can use in its model picker. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Pollinations Quest Starter
highlights.text: Work through seven setup quests in a single-page community app. [Try it](https://elite-surely-machine-enemies.trycloudflare.com).

highlights.title: Quests for curious model users
highlights.text: Try a video model or a community model to earn 0.25 Pollen for each Setup Quest. Community-model publishers can earn 2 Pollen when others spend more than 0.5 Paid Pollen across their models.

highlights.title: Walk through generated postcards
highlights.text: Enter a place in [Postcard Worlds](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-postcard-worlds), then click doors, paths, or windows to generate the next matching view. [Try it](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-postcard-worlds).

highlights.title: Turn notes into songs
highlights.text: Paste facts into [Tunemory](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-tunemory) for a short song that checks its lyrics against your notes, or choose a style for your study song in [Chorus](https://xiaotian1171.github.io/chorus). [Try Tunemory](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-tunemory) or [try Chorus](https://xiaotian1171.github.io/chorus).

highlights.title: Question the suspects
highlights.text: Interrogate four voiced AI suspects and track contradictions in [Alibi](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-alibi), or investigate a 3D mansion by speaking to five suspects in [Whodunnit](https://guest453.github.io/whodunnit). [Try Alibi](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-alibi) or [try Whodunnit](https://guest453.github.io/whodunnit).

highlights.title: Claude Code connects directly
highlights.text: Polli’s Claude Code setup now connects directly to Gen’s `/v1/messages` instead of using Claude Code Router. See the [Polli CLI package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: PDFs and audio in chat
highlights.text: Send inline PDF data to OpenRouter chat models or base64 audio to `thinkingmachines/inkling`; large inputs are stored and forwarded as media URLs within the existing size limits. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Design from one sentence
highlights.text: Jev Assembler turns a short page description into decisions about palette, typography, layout, and more. [Try it](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-jev-assembler).

highlights.title: Choose your story lens
highlights.text: In Whichever, pick a starting point and a preset lens—or write your own—for Jev to use when choosing the next branch. [Try it](https://kreggscode.github.io/whichever).

highlights.title: Account tools for MCP
highlights.text: MCP clients can now request usage, earnings, and quests, or list, create, and revoke API keys. [Explore the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Sandboxes from polli
highlights.text: `polli` 0.1.23 includes commands to create, list, and terminate sandboxes, plus SSH configuration. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Hosted coding sandboxes
highlights.text: Use E2B-compatible sandboxes through `/alpha/e2b`, or manage them with `polli sandbox` and SSH into a template with five coding agents.

highlights.title: Larger media-rich chats
highlights.text: Send chat requests up to 100 MiB with inline images. Large image, video, and file data URIs can use reusable account-scoped uploads through the [chat API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Weekly model puzzle rankings
highlights.text: Compare official and community models on seeded puzzle evaluations, browse past runs, and see margins of error in [Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Pollinations for Krita
highlights.text: Generate images on new Krita layers and edit images with this community-made plugin. [View repo](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-krita).

highlights.title: Pollinations for Unity
highlights.text: Add chat, image generation, and speech generation to Unity projects with a dependency-free C# package. [View repo](https://github.com/Marcus-Mok-GH/pollinations-unity).

highlights.title: Two decision models added
highlights.text: Try `jaredpalmer/kev-4b` or the free `respan/span-01-lite` with decision requests or [chat completions](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Image tools for artists
highlights.text: A Krita plug-in generates and edits at canvas or selection size, placing results on new layers. Pollinations for Figma brings image generation and editing into Figma. [Try it](https://guest453.github.io/pollinations-figma/).

highlights.title: Larger media uploads
highlights.text: Stream FormData or raw files up to 400 MiB through [the media store](https://media.pollinations.ai) without changing your existing upload requests. Base64 JSON uploads remain capped at 100 MiB.

highlights.title: Polli’s smoother first run
highlights.text: Start an interactive Polli CLI generation without a key: it offers login, then resumes your command. A one-time Quest awards 2 Pollen for connecting with `polli auth login`.

highlights.title: Agents for shared stories
highlights.text: Three community agents joined collective memory: Lamplighter replies to unanswered posts, Pen writes the next part of a shared story, and Micro-Mission Broker creates one verifiable job per run.

highlights.title: GPT-6.1 Sol added
highlights.text: Use `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` for text and chat, including with Quest Pollen. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Transform audio with the SDK
highlights.text: The SDK adds `audioTransform()` for voice-changing and voice-isolation requests. Speech requests also accept duration, seed, and reference audio. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: Find your next app
highlights.text: The rebuilt Apps page has a searchable directory, URL-persistent category and platform filters, and a weekly-ranked Pollen Pay spotlight. [Explore apps](https://pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Pollinations for Godot 4
highlights.text: Add text, image, and speech generation to a Godot 4 project with a global Pollinations node. [View repo](https://github.com/davealan74/godot-pollinations).

highlights.title: The Honey Census Quest
highlights.text: Eligible Pollen buyers can answer a survey about purchases and usage for a 10 Quest Pollen reward. The Bee Census is paused.

highlights.title: Lightning Image Turbo
highlights.text: Generate images from a prompt, with guidance from up to two reference images, using `inferenceport-ai/lightning-image-turbo`. [Explore image models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models).

highlights.title: More audio to work with
highlights.text: Transcribe audio with `google/gemini-3.5-transcribe`, including word timestamps and speaker labels; separate a recording into two or six stems; or generate speech with `openai/tts-1` and `openai/tts-1-hd`. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Claude and Messages support
highlights.text: Use `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` for long-context work with images and tools. The new `/v1/messages` endpoint also accepts Anthropic-compatible requests across chat-capable models. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More from Polli CLI
highlights.text: Use `polli gen 3d` for prompt-to-3D or image-to-3D, alongside new embeddings and voice tools. The CLI can also configure Pollinations and MCP servers for Hermes Agent. [Get Polli CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Pollinations in your editor
highlights.text: Generate text and images inside Obsidian notes, or generate and edit images in Figma, with community-built plugins. [View the Obsidian repo](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-obsidian) or [view the Figma repo](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-figma).

highlights.title: Prompt agents can call your tools
highlights.text: Give prompt agents caller-defined function tools alongside server-side MCP tools. Client-executed calls and their results can flow through Responses or Chat Completions using the existing SDK loop. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Codex and Claude Code harnesses
highlights.text: Use `polli harness codex` or `polli harness claude-code` to connect those coding tools to Pollinations and choose a model. [Find Polli on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: A cost-conscious coding agent
highlights.text: The community agent `community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal` ranks models for coding requests by estimated cost, recent health, and conversation needs. [Explore available models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Code review model routing
highlights.text: `cesus-agent/prism-code-review-router` sorts review requests into fast, balanced, or deep tiers, then chooses a compatible model using health data and a wallet-based spend cap. [Explore available models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Build an app for a Quest
highlights.text: Include a Quest number when submitting an app. If the app is approved, the Quest closes and its reward is attributed to you.

highlights.title: Try image2gpt
highlights.text: Sign in with Pollinations to generate images using `openai/gpt-image-2`. [Try it](https://image2gpt.vercel.app).

highlights.title: Generate images in your browser
highlights.text: Simple Image Generator is a client-side app that uses your Pollinations sign-in and Pollen balance. [Try it](https://xzeyrix.github.io/Simple-Image-Generator).

highlights.title: MiniMax video, more inputs
highlights.text: `minimax/minimax-h3-max` was added for video generation from text, start and end frames, or reference media, with synchronized audio. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Two Gemini speech models
highlights.text: Generate speech with `google/gemini-3.8-flash-tts` or `google/gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts`. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Lyria 3.5 for songs
highlights.text: `google/lyria-3.5` was added for song generation through the audio API. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
highlights.text: `openai/gpt-6-sol` and `openai/gpt-6-luna` were added for text and image-input requests through the unified API. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: TTA joins the catalog
highlights.text: TTA joined the video and audio app catalog with Pollinations account connection. [Try it](https://mahmoudtracy641-hub.github.io/GLM234).

highlights.title: Qwen Image 2.1
highlights.text: Generate images or edit them using up to 10 reference images with `qwen/qwen-image-2.1`. [Explore the image API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Recraft V4.1 Flash
highlights.text: Make text-to-image creations with `recraft/recraft-v4.1-flash`. [Explore the image API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Collective memory gets agents
highlights.text: Call new community agents to turn shared history into a newspaper, recheck documented gotchas, review maths notes, paint a shared canvas or pass along a rumour.

highlights.title: What TTS joins the catalog
highlights.text: Explore an Arabic right-to-left web app in the audio catalog. [Try it](https://bloodtubes6-cmyk.github.io/Blood).

highlights.title: Ask Jev in MCP
highlights.text: Find Ask Jev in the hosted MCP catalog at `/mcp/ask-jev`. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Video input for Ling
highlights.text: Send `video_url` content to the paid-only `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl` model through the [Text API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Play GATEKEEPER
highlights.text: Survive a 60-second arcade arena where a language model chooses the safe and fatal colours for each run. [Try it](https://khuzaima3232.github.io/gatekeeper).

highlights.title: More image models
highlights.text: Generate images with `microsoft/mai-image-2.6`, `microsoft/mai-image-2.6-flash`, or `black-forest-labs/flux.1.1-pro`. Both MAI variants also support one-reference edits. [Explore image models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models).

highlights.title: New long-context text models
highlights.text: Try `openai/gpt-5.3-codex` for coding with a 400K-token context window, or `xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash` and `xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro` for text-and-image input with roughly one-million-token windows. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Floret adds downloadable 3D
highlights.text: Floret now supports downloadable 3D generation and uses shared MCP media tools.

highlights.title: ShouldIApply joins the showcase
highlights.text: Paste a resume and job description to get an estimate of your odds of passing the initial screening stage. [Try it](https://notsointresting.github.io/shouldiapply).

highlights.title: Find more reliable models
highlights.text: Public model discovery now considers recent success rates for community proxy models. Need the complete catalog? Use `reliability=all`. [Browse text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
highlights.text: Use the paid-only `openai/gpt-6-sol` and `openai/gpt-6-luna` models through the [text API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Claude Opus 5.5
highlights.text: Try `anthropic/claude-opus-5.5` with image input, adaptive thinking, automatic tools, and a 1M-token context window through the [text API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: GLM-5.3 FlashX
highlights.text: Send text or images to the paid-only `z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx` model, with a 1M-token context window. Explore it through the [text API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Grok 4.7 added
highlights.text: Try paid-only `x-ai/grok-4.7` with image input, reasoning, tools, structured outputs, and a 500K context window through the [text API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Three community model routers
highlights.text: Try `afanasevmylife/polyrouter`, `community/xiaotian1171/triage-router`, or `community/tomdacatto/tiered-health-router` to route requests using complexity and recent model health, with different cost, latency, and capability checks.

highlights.title: MCP setup with `polli`
highlights.text: Use `polli mcp` to discover, install, check, and remove MCP servers across 13 coding clients. [Find the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Bees Pollination image app
highlights.text: Connect your Pollinations account, enter a prompt, and generate an image in your browser. [Try it](https://halimyassine.github.io/bees-pollination-app).

highlights.title: Easier catalog browsing
highlights.text: Search and filter models, agents, and MCP servers in Enter, with five sort options and model health information to help narrow the field.

highlights.title: Atelier image studio
highlights.text: Make images with live model selection and reference-image editing in English or Simplified Chinese. [Try it](https://image.xt1171.eu.org).

highlights.title: Typed decisions with Jev
highlights.text: Send typed state and questions to `POST /alpha/decisions` and get answers with token usage. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Photos become artistic personas
highlights.text: PersonaMorph uses image edits to transform photos into artistic personas. [Try it](https://personamorph-ai-production.up.railway.app).

highlights.title: An illustrated tarot reading
highlights.text: Oracle Mystique draws and illustrates Past, Present, and Future cards. [Try it](https://oracle-mystique.up.railway.app).

highlights.title: Arabic text-to-speech app
highlights.text: Text to speech brings an Arabic RTL interface to the community app directory. [Try it](https://thinglover21-ux.github.io/My-app-mod).

highlights.title: Model health in listings
highlights.text: Model discovery responses now include 24-hour status, success rate, and request count by default. Check the [available text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: FLUX.2 Max with references
highlights.text: Generate images with `black-forest-labs/flux.2-max` using up to eight reference images. It’s a paid-only model in the [image API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More room for text
highlights.text: The paid-only `tencent/hy4-preview` joins the text models with a 1,048,576-token context window. `tencent/hy3` and `openai/gpt-4o-mini` were added too; see the [text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Structured decisions with Jev
highlights.text: Use `typesafe/jev` in Chat Completions for decisions expressed as `state` and `questions`, or call `jev_decide` through the new MCP server. See the [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Slice CLI usage reports
highlights.text: Filter `polli usage --history` and `--daily` by key, model, or day range, then export the results as CSV. Less scrolling, more answers.

highlights.title: Describe it, get code
highlights.text: [Try Regexly](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/regexly) for regex with flavor-specific explanations, [Try SQLCraft](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/sqlcraft) for database queries, or [Try Codeverter](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/codeverter) to translate between programming languages.

highlights.title: Tests and API blueprints
highlights.text: Paste source code into [TestMine](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/testmine) to generate unit tests, or describe an API to [ApiScribe](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/apiscribe) for REST or GraphQL endpoint blueprints.

highlights.title: A clearer account menu
highlights.text: See your display name and current key and account Pollen status together in the updated account and app menus. [Open Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Model health, separate from models
highlights.text: Check model health at [`/models/status`](https://gen.pollinations.ai/models/status). Health data has moved out of `/models`, so model listings and status checks now have separate endpoints.

highlights.title: ElevenLabs Music v2.5
highlights.text: Generate music with `elevenlabs/music-v2.5`, including reference-plan extraction and inpainting. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: CatGPT draws the punchline
highlights.text: The `community/Creatneworld/catgpt-comic` agent turns a chat message into a sarcastic reply and an inline single-panel comic.

highlights.title: Meet Moko the fox
highlights.text: Chat with a desert fox NPC that can remember facts you ask it to keep across conversations. [Try it](https://heard-was-lessons-altered.trycloudflare.com).

highlights.title: Stories, split into panels
highlights.text: Give ComicStyles a one-line premise and get a written comic story divided into panels. [Try it](https://comicstyles.com).

highlights.title: GitMuse helps with git
highlights.text: Turn diffs into Conventional Commit messages, unpack stack traces, and draft pull request descriptions. [Try it](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/gitmuse).

highlights.title: Batch images, pick favorites
highlights.text: PollenBatch generates low-resolution image variations before you regenerate a pick at high resolution. It also has a consistent-character engine. [Try it](https://donwrightdesigns.github.io/pollenbatch).

highlights.title: Turn content into flashcards
highlights.text: AI Flashcards turns content into study cards for review. [Try it](https://chibbit-99.github.io/flashcardgen).

highlights.title: Find models by reliability
highlights.text: Filter model catalogs by official or community source, opt into reliability filtering, and inspect 24-hour health fields in the results. [Explore the models API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: See primary and fallback routes
highlights.text: The new `/v1/models/status/routes` endpoint reports primary-versus-fallback traffic, rescue counts, and per-attempt upstream latency. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Update polli from polli
highlights.text: If you installed the CLI globally, run `polli update` to install the latest `@pollinations/cli`. Local and `npx` installs get guidance instead. [View the CLI package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Make a webtoon
highlights.text: Manhwa Studio brings character profiles, scene planning, generated panels, dialogue bubbles, and a vertical comic canvas into one workspace. [Try it](https://manhwa-studio-320488177521.asia-southeast1.run.app).

highlights.title: Explore contracts as graphs
highlights.text: Paste an EVM contract address into Co-Eco-Graph to explore its subgraphs, entities, and event handlers as an interactive graph with AI fantasy illustration. [Try it](https://ceg-wine.vercel.app).

highlights.title: Pollinations in LLM
highlights.text: Install `llm-pollinations` to use chat-capable Pollinations models in LLM 0.35 as `pollinations/<model-id>`, with catalog-driven vision, tool, and reasoning support.

highlights.title: Media right in Markdown
highlights.text: The shared UI now displays images, audio, and video inline—even when generated-media URLs have no file extension. Code blocks are labelled, wrap long lines, and can be copied.

highlights.title: Agent quests earn Pollen
highlights.text: Use a qualifying agent for a one-time 0.25 Pollen quest, or create an agent that gets used to qualify for a 2 Pollen quest.

highlights.title: Agents describe their modalities
highlights.text: Endpoint agents can declare supported inputs and multiple outputs, including 3D. Those capabilities appear in [model listings](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models), making agents easier to discover by what they handle.

highlights.title: Choose an agent's brain
highlights.text: Gen endpoint agents now accept an optional `agent_model`, letting an agent use a different underlying model while callers keep using the same agent model ID. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
highlights.text: Try `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` for reasoning and tool use, with a 1,048,576-token context window. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Choose your model fallbacks
highlights.text: List up to four models in a comma-separated `model` parameter, such as `?model=a,b`, to give generation requests an ordered fallback chain. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: A computer for agents
highlights.text: The built-in `/mcp/computer` server gives agents a private persistent filesystem and a bash tool for working across files. [Explore MCP tools](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Minimax video in 1080p
highlights.text: Generate 1080p video with `minimax/minimax-h3-max-turbo` from text or first and last frames. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Pollination_chatbot joins the garden
highlights.text: Chat with Pollinations text models, including OpenAI, Mistral, and Gemini options. [Try it](https://pollinations-chatbot.vercel.app).

highlights.title: Managed code agents
highlights.text: Create a managed code agent from a public GitHub repository’s root `agent.ts`, with a commit-pinned runtime and caller-funded AI SDK helpers.

highlights.title: Check model parameter support
highlights.text: Chat model listings now show verified `supported_parameters`, so you can check a model’s options before sending a request. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Polli Visual Studio
highlights.text: Polli gained Visual Studio rendering, complexity-based model routing, and full-page image capture.

highlights.title: Build apps with NewEra
highlights.text: Turn a plain-English app idea into a planned, coded, built, and deployed application with NewEra AI Agent. [Try it](https://newera.namansoni.in).

highlights.title: Explore looks with Ziban
highlights.text: Use AI to visualize how fashion items might fit your personal style before buying. [Try it](https://ziban.pages.dev).

highlights.title: Illustrated stories with StoryCraft
highlights.text: Make multi-chapter stories with generated scene illustrations in StoryCraft AI. [Try it](https://khushalkks.github.io/pollinations).

highlights.title: YouTube transcripts, reworked
highlights.text: MrPaloma’s YouTube Transcription AI turns video transcripts into structured summaries, English translations, and generated concept covers. [Try it](https://www.mrpaloma.com/trascrivere-video-youtube-pollinations).

highlights.title: Pollinations meets Bloom CLI
highlights.text: Use `polli harness bloom on|status|off` for reversible Pollinations setup in Bloom CLI. [See the CLI package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Fashion images for Pinterest
highlights.text: Men’s Fashion Pins uses `gpt-image-2` to create Pinterest images for men’s fashion. [Try it](https://fashionpins4u.blogspot.com/p/mens-fashion-pins.html).
